text:
sasha: hi all — last question before start: i have a personal M1 Mac. do i need to enroll it in MDM to get through the phishing sim and access docs? also where do i find the security training link?

dom: hey sasha, welcome! phishsim is sent to accounts, so you'll get it regardless of device. we only require MDM on company-issued machines. personal devices are allowed but will have limited access to internal tools. training link gets emailed after your account is active (should be within 24h).

it-help: FYI laptop ETA: arriving tomorrow. If you later need to enroll macOS manually: 1) SSO to Company Portal 2) install "Redwood MDM" profile 3) enable FileVault. Terminal fallback: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment`. Ping us if enrollment errors.

sam-security: phishsim cadence: week 1 sims start day 3. If you click a simulated phish you'll be routed to a short remediation module (3-5m). Mandatory course is "Security Essentials" in LMS — due within 7 days. If you prefer to keep personal device off-MDM, DM me and we'll adjust app access.

onboard-bot: reminder: complete New-Joiner Security checklist within 7 days: MDM (company devices), FileVault, MFA, Security Essentials course, sign AUP.

sasha: awesome, thanks! tagging if I hit any enrollment snags @it-help."
